# TASK-015: Polymarket Local EIP-712 Signing

GOAL: Implement local EIP-712 order signing for Polymarket CLOB API without transmitting private keys over network
TIMELINE: 1 day

## Task Checklist

### Phase 1: Research & Setup
- [ ] Research Polymarket CLOB API EIP-712 signing requirements
- [ ] Create `backend/signing/__init__.py` - Module initialization
- [ ] Add required dependencies (eth-account, web3)

### Phase 2: EIP-712 Implementation
- [ ] Create `backend/signing/eip712.py` - EIP-712 typed data signing
- [ ] Implement domain separator for Polymarket
- [ ] Implement Order struct types
- [ ] Implement sign_typed_data function

### Phase 3: Polymarket Integration
- [ ] Create `backend/signing/polymarket_signer.py` - Polymarket-specific signing
- [ ] Integrate with Vault for private key loading
- [ ] Implement order signing with proper types
- [ ] Ensure private key never leaves memory

### Phase 4: Testing & Validation
- [ ] Create `tests/test_eip712_signing.py` - Unit tests
- [ ] Test mock order signing
- [ ] Verify signature format matches API docs
- [ ] Update tasks.json status to done

## Success Criteria
- [ ] EIP-712 signing implemented correctly
- [ ] Private keys loaded from vault, never transmitted
- [ ] Signatures match Polymarket CLOB API format
- [ ] All tests pass
- [ ] No private key leakage to logs/stdout

## Technical Requirements

### EIP-712 Components:
- Domain separator (chainId, verifyingContract)
- Order struct (maker, taker, tokenId, makerToken, takerToken, etc.)
- Typed data signing with eth_account

### Security:
- Private keys loaded from vault only
- Keys stored in memory only during signing
- No key transmission over network
- No key leakage to logs

## Dependencies
- TASK-014 ✅ (Vault for secure key storage)
